== Biography ==
James Glasgow was born about 1787. He was a son of [[Glasgow-1983|Robert Glasgow]] and is currently attached to [[Kinard-572|Elizabeth Kinard]] as his mother. James died before the 1835 partition of Robert's estate.

The partition directly identifies the deceased James as Robert's son and names James's children Archibald C., Robert, James and Spencer.<ref name="RobertEstate1835">Newberry District, South Carolina, equity partition of the estate of Robert Glasgow, 1835; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSR8-XSB3-K FamilySearch image].</ref> It proves Robert as James's father. The proceeding does not identify James's mother.
